title: Slats Long, Jack Purvis and other names
summary: Duerr knew Slats Long and Jack Purvis but did not work much with them.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. Slats Long. Yeah, yeah. I knew Slats Long. He played with Froeberg quite a bit. Some job, different things, yeah. And Herbie Hamer? Yeah. You knew him too? Yeah. Oh yeah.
And what about Jack Purvis, did you know him?

Like I told you, I knew Jack, he was always around the street then. I never worked with Jack much, in fact I never worked at all with him at all. I can recall, but I knew him quite well. I don't think I looked good at anything with Jack.

And Carol Waldron, did you know him? Yeah, I was a man but I can't recall. And Eddie Doherty? No. Did you ever hear these tunes? Yeah, I was a man but I can't recall him. And Eddie Doherty? No. Did you ever hear these tunes? Church Maus on Espres?
I heard the title, yeah, but I don't remember him. No. Did you ever hear these tunes, Church Mouse on a Spree?
I heard the title, yeah, but I don't know the tune or anything. Yeah. If I hear it, maybe I might know it.
